Welcome to South Wales' oldest triathlon club, where tradition meets excellence! With our extensive experience and a variety of coached sessions, we are dedicated to helping athletes of all levels achieve their goals. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or just starting your triathlon journey, our knowledgeable coaches provide the guidance and support you need to excel Join us and become part of a community that celebrates every achievement!
